_about: The tour's missions. `after` lists the missions that must be passed first; the tour map is their Hasse diagram, each mission's level the length of its longest chain of `after` (crates/core/src/tour.rs). `goal.kind` is one of height, tricks, routine, roof, popcorn, tower, trapeze, juggle; the fields each needs are read in tour.rs. `unlock` is a costume id from costumes.json. `brief` is what the map shows before a mission, in the order a player needs it.

missions.name: Find your bounce
missions.brief: Hold Space to push the trampoline as it throws you up. Each push takes you higher. Reach 3 metres three times. Press C to stop bouncing.

missions.name: Seat drop
missions.brief: Hold K for a pike as you come down, and you land sitting with your legs out. The trampoline throws you back to your feet. Do two seat drops.

missions.name: First flip
missions.brief: Bounce high, then hold S while the trampoline throws you up to set a back flip turning. Hold J to tuck and spin faster, and let go to open out before you land.

missions.name: The popcorn machine overflows
missions.brief: The machine in the truck's window is spilling popcorn over the trampoline. Catch 12 pieces in a minute. Any part of you catches it.

missions.name: Up on the truck
missions.brief: Bounce high, then hold the up arrow as the trampoline throws you up to travel toward the truck. Land on your feet on the roof.

missions.name: Two-ball warm-up
missions.brief: Press A or D to throw the first ball. Then press A as a ball drops into the hand on the left of the screen, and D for the hand on the right. A ring lights up under a hand when it is time. Ten catches.

missions.name: Durham finale
missions.brief: Four tricks without a fall, worth 60 points together. Bounces between them are fine; a fall starts the count again. Seat drops, back drops, flips and twists all count.

missions.name: Front tuck and barani
missions.brief: W sets a front flip turning. A barani is a front flip with a half twist: hold A or D through the push as well.

missions.name: Four chairs high
missions.brief: Stack chairs on the table on the truck's roof and stand on top. The tower leans and the wind pushes it; WASD or the arrows push the top back. Press Space to bring up the next chair, and when four are up, Space again for a handstand. Hold it two seconds.

missions.name: Three-ball cascade
missions.brief: A third ball and a quicker rhythm: A for the hand on the left of the screen, D for the right, when its ring lights. Twelve catches.

missions.name: Swivel hips and a cradle
missions.brief: From a seat drop, hold A or D as you leave the trampoline for a half twist into another seat drop: swivel hips. Tap S for a quarter turn onto your back: a back drop. From your back, A or D twists you onto your back again: a cradle.

missions.name: First trapeze
missions.brief: The trapeze is the game's addition to the show. Hold W while you swing forward and S while you swing back to swing higher. Press Space to let go, and land on your feet on the trampoline.

missions.name: Trapeze back tuck
missions.brief: Let go at the front of the swing and the swing's own turn starts a back flip. Tuck with J, open out, land on your feet.

missions.name: Back full
missions.brief: A back flip with a full twist. Hold S and A or D together through the push, stay straight, and the twist comes round.

missions.name: Popcorn storm
missions.brief: Twenty-five pieces in a minute. Bounce high: the popcorn starts up near the window.

missions.name: Flip onto the truck
missions.brief: Any flip that lands on the roof. A back tuck with the up arrow held, or a front tuck toward the truck.

missions.name: Double back
missions.brief: Two back flips in one flight. Get high first, hold S through the whole contact, and tuck tight.

missions.name: Eight chairs high
missions.brief: Eight chairs, then a three-second handstand. The taller it gets, the slower it leans and the further it goes before you notice.

missions.name: Rudy
missions.brief: A front flip with one and a half twists. W and A or D through the push, then stay straight.

missions.name: Five in a row
missions.brief: Five tricks without a fall, worth 160 points. Mix in the flips.

missions.name: Trapeze double
missions.brief: Swing high, let go at the front, hold S and a tight tuck for two back flips to the trampoline.

missions.name: Long cascade
missions.brief: Thirty catches with three balls.

missions.name: Popcorn over the playground
missions.brief: Thirty-five pieces in seventy-five seconds. The roof is close to the window.

missions.name: Thirty-five feet
missions.brief: Twelve chairs on the table on the truck: about thirty-five feet, as high as the show's own tower. Then a handstand.

missions.name: Full-in
missions.brief: A double back with a full twist in the first flip. Hold S and a twist key through the push.

missions.name: Grand finale
missions.brief: The last show of the tour. Six tricks without a fall, worth 300 points.
